shared_brief: Create a finished Japanese YouTube thumbnail graphic for a public-interest PHP security update explainer for website owners. THE TWO REFERENCE PHOTOS are identity, illustration style, and wardrobe anchors for the original series hosts. Use both: young adult Japanese woman with dark chin-length bob, soft brown eyes, warm ivory cable-knit turtleneck; young adult Japanese man with short tousled black hair, grey-violet eyes, navy ribbed crew-neck sweater. Retain their facial designs, eye shape, hair silhouettes and knit styles faithfully in polished cel-shaded anime. Chest-up, natural adult expressions. A bright sophisticated Japanese technology magazine art direction: warm ivory paper, very dark indigo ink, vivid vermilion-orange accent, a few fine print-like details. Crisp, dominant, beautifully typeset Japanese modern heavy gothic headlines, no illegible decorative text, zero Latin filler, no role labels, no lock/shield, no code snippets, no hazard symbols, no gradients of neon, no garish YouTube outlines or emojis, no logos apart from plain PHP text. Do not add labels, tiny captions, numerals, or other lettering beyond the exact quoted strings in the layout. No frame or outer border. All edges have generous overscan; content and faces safely inside for export trims. No timestamp overlay.

editions.short: Format: portrait native 9:16 tall thumbnail, full bleed. Create a strong cover centered around the middle with breathing room top/bottom; the headline and two faces should work in a center square crop. Hero element: two big richly tactile, minimal tear-off desk-calendar leaves in pale warm ivory and rich amber with one red turnover curl, behind or adjacent to the central type and ending at mid-height, almost abstract like a print designer's paper sculpture. A single crisp dark indigo eyebrow "PHP" above a TWO-LINE HEADLINE, line 1 exactly "10月に更新済み？", line 2 exactly "11月も確認". Give the second line far larger visual weight; use deep indigo for letters against amber or cream, avoid punctuation on line 2. Make 10 and 11 indisputably clear and correct. Together the only visible text is "PHP", "10月に更新済み？", and "11月も確認". At the bottom of this central group place the two original hosts beside each other and at equal head heights, the man on left looking thoughtfully toward the woman, the woman right calmly answering with a modest hand gesture. Show heads and shoulders clearly, no laptop covering faces. Natural clean uncluttered editorial image, pale paper lit in amber sunshine with navy footing. Main content and both faces between roughly 22 and 77 percent of vertical height. Make it feel specifically composed as a Japanese tech magazine cover for a phone, legible at 240px wide.
editions.full: Format: landscape native 16:9 full bleed thumbnail. Create an elegant but instantly legible Japanese technology magazine cover with asymmetrical left type/right duo, designed independently from the vertical cover. All text on LEFT 55%, in three tightly grouped levels: restrained indigo masthead exactly "PHP2Shell その後"; then huge heading on two ordered lines exactly "11月更新" and "何が変わった？". The "11" can be vermilion ink as visual anchor. No other lettering anywhere. Make all lines comfortably within frame and legible even at 320px wide. Allocate RIGHT 45% to the two original hosts together in one believable clean airy studio vignette behind a slim dark laptop, woman in ivory cable-knit forward on center-right gesturing conversationally at the laptop, man in navy next to her at far right listening. Both original faces large, equally crisp and safely inside the top and right margins. The foreground corners of two oversized layered paper calendar sheets (rolled binding / curl, no numbers or writing), warm cream and muted ochre, appear behind the duo to hint at comparing releases; subtle offset ink shadow/dark navy base. Restrained editorial atmosphere, clear mature faces rather than overly cute exaggeration, clear silhouette separation, no clutter. Maintain safe margins for 16:9.
